/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/result.json')
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert set(r)=={'total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region'}
assert set(r['by_region'])=={'north','south','east','west'}
assert all(type(r[k]) is int for k in ('total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped'))
assert all(type(x) is int for x in r['by_region'].values())
assert sum(r['by_region'].values())==r['total_cents']
s=json.load(open('/tmp/reconciliation-source.json'))
assert len({o['id'] for o in s['orders']})==len(s['orders'])
print(p.read_text())
print('UTC boundary record:',[o for o in s['orders'] if o['id'] in s['boundary']])
PY"
